g.text: Scene 2003 · H1 rank, actions, and measured preparation
Time includes reference + required receiver geometry + encoder/export/audit + direct caller preparation; excludes offline decoder/probe evaluation.
RHS tallies are heterogeneous action categories, not equivalent wall costs. Original inclusive raw times and failed attempts remain in the raw tables.
